scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "pnpm --filter client dev" "pnpm dev:server"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:client: pnpm --filter client exec eslint . --max-warnings 0 && pnpm --filter client exec prettier --check src && pnpm --filter client run type-check
scripts.lint:server: cd server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
